threads.subject: UT Austin Student Highly Interested in Union Square Advisors' Summer 2025 Internship Program

messages.subject: UT Austin Student Highly Interested in Union Square Advisors' Summer 2025 Internship Program
messages.body:
Hello Union Square Advisors Recruiting Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I am emailing to emphasize my interest in recruiting with USA for the Summer Analyst 2025 Program. I am from Los Angeles, and I'm now studying Economics and Business at the University of Texas - Austin. I'm sure your firm doesn't receive many applications from UT students, if any at all, so I wanted to send this email to reaffirm my interest in your firm, having already submitted my online application.

I am particularly interested in a boutique, tech-focused firm and was very pleased to learn about the offerings of your internship program as they greatly align with what I am looking for. I hope this email highlights my strong interest in recruiting with Union Square Advisors. Please feel free to reach out to me with any additional questions.

Best,
Jonathan Nachman
messages.note: Sent to a shared inbox (info@), not a person. Never answered.
